title: Woman & Boy Riding Ponies, 1964 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white square border snapshot from November 1964 capturing a boy and a woman enjoying a pony ride along a dirt driveway or quiet road on a sunny day. The young boy in front wears a short-sleeved checkered shirt, while the woman behind him on the adjacent pony wears a light top and cropped trousers. The photo edge is stamped with the date NOV . 64.
